limitations.text: No imagery could be read: imagery_window returned 'not_allowed: this task has no imagery source' for both gsi-seamless-aerial-japan and sentinel-2-l2a-cogs (r-0015, r-0017). Existence and warehouse-vs-factory could not be checked visually. The only evidence is a linear probe on the aef-10m-annual index (160 m cells, 3430 cells, 70x49 grid, year 2024). This index is flagged synthetic (synthetic-aef-v1, 16-d, 10 m signal pooled to 160 m), and 160 m is coarser than a ~40 m building. The probe was trained on 16 PLATEAU training points, which fall on a regular lat/lon grid and may not be warehouses. Its scores (r-0013) show no spatial clustering and look noisy, so I judged them unfit to place building points. I did not run aggregate. I did not use Clay (1280 m cells too coarse). Searched: the full AOI 136.82-136.92E, 35.05-35.12N, embeddings only. Reviewed visually: none, so the whole AOI (~60 km2) is unreviewed. Count: cannot be estimated reliably; range 0 to unknown, with no confirmed warehouses.

understanding.goal_restated: Find all warehouses (>=~1600 m2 logistics/storage buildings) in the AOI near Nagoya/Tokai (136.82-136.92E, 35.05-35.12N), excluding factories, markets, hangars, and report points, evidence, count range and unreviewed area.
